lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately six visible vertical columns of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the gill slits, with inter-blob spacing increasing in the posterior direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of slightly higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot alignments, forming a semi-rectilinear grid where spots are centered within the intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal-lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high-intensity luminance on the upper edge to low-intensity shadow on the lower edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small-bodied fish (remoras) are visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral flank; the anterior cranial region exhibits a high-density field of micro-spots compared to the more organized maculation of the lateral flank.
